messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: traffic anomaly detected for org=AuroraEdge (zone=us-west-2). 95th p99 latency increase and 429 rate-limited responses observed. spike_start=2351112180
Ana (SRE): I’m on it. Paging SRE oncall and infra. Can someone grab client impact and recent deploys?
Mike (CS): Customers reporting sustained 429s on generate and embed endpoints, ~8 customers complaining via support, no code changes on their side. Seeing an org-level spike in qps for AuroraEdge.
Raj Patel: No deploys from our side in last 30m. Telemetry shows sudden traffic fan-out from a frontend job for AuroraEdge-batch that started at ~2351112175.
Tess (Infra): Looking at routing. org quota enforcement hitting at infra layer. We have RL policy: org_default_qps=200, org_burst=400. AuroraEdge is currently at sustained ~1200 qps.
Ana (SRE): Impact: high for that org; others unaffected. We need a mitigation path: options are immediate org RL bump, temporary rule to shape traffic, or disable batch job at customer side (ask them).
Mike (CS): I can reach out to AuroraEdge product owner to throttle their batch job, but we need faster mitigation while we wait for their response.
Raj Patel: I can do a hotfix to raise their org cap. We have admin endpoint: POST /internal/orgs/{org_id}/quota-override. Propose 3x for 15m then auto-revert.
Tess (Infra): If we do override, we should route them to a cheaper model variant to reduce load, and enable prefix cache for frequent requests. But prefix cache won't help immediate embed traffic.
Ana (SRE): Consensus: apply temporary quota_override to avoid customer-facing errors, but keep global safety — add a circuit that caps overall node qps. Execute with a manual rollback plan and alerting.
Nina (Oncall): I’ll take oncall for the next steps and own rollback. Handing off to me now.
Ana (SRE): @Nina please coordinate runbook and execute. Steps below.
Tess (Infra): Runbook snippet (admin CLI):
```
# give AuroraEdge a temporary qps bump for 15m
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/orgs/auroraedge/quota-override \
  -d '{"qps":600,"burst":1200,"expires_at":"2351113400","actor":"oncall"}'
```
Raj Patel: I’ll execute the CLI now. Will also add a per-node throttle policy to keep cluster safe: node_max_qps=15000.
Raj Patel: (exec) POST returned 200 — override applied. override_id=ov-7b9f.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: quota-override ov-7b9f applied by raj.patel at 2351112287
Mike (CS): Support reports 429s dropping but API latency still elevated. Customers receiving fewer errors now. I’m pinging AuroraEdge to ask them to backoff batch job or switch to incremental mode.
Tess (Infra): Metrics: org qps dropped from 1200 -> 620 after override and improved error rate. Node CPU increased ~10% but within buffer.
Ana (SRE): Good. Set monitoring alert for any downstream cascading errors: increases in queue length or OOMs.
Nina (Oncall): I’m enabling an intermediate traffic-shaper for AuroraEdge on the edge LB to smooth burstiness. Edge config snippet:
```
# rate-shaper rule
match: header["x-org-id"] == "auroraedge"
action: token_bucket(rate=600, burst=1200)
apply: edge-priority=3
```
Tess (Infra): Edge rule applied. Confirming no impact on other orgs.
Raj Patel: Logged the change in ops incident tracker: INC-235111-auroraedge. Noted override_id and rollback time.
Ana (SRE): @Mike can you confirm the account team has communicated the need for a fix on their side (throttle batch)?
Mike (CS): Reached out — AuroraEdge acknowledged and will pause the batch job for 20 minutes, then re-run with paging.
Nina (Oncall): Setting automatic rollback at expires_at=2351113400 (15m). I will monitor dashboards and manually rollback earlier if we see node strain.
Ana (SRE): After-action items: 1) Evaluate org-level autoscaling rules for sudden fan-outs, 2) add an automated soft-fallback to cheaper model variants for high qps orgs, 3) improve customer guidance for bulk jobs.
Tess (Infra): Suggest adding a protective pre-check that flags orgs with sudden x5 increase within 60s and auto-apply a soft-throttle before hitting RL. Filing infra ticket.
Raj Patel: Rollback executed at 2351113400 (auto-revert). deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: quota-override ov-7b9f expired and reverted.
Mike (CS): Customer reports system stable, no more 429s. They re-ran job with pacing and it completed.
Ana (SRE): Closing incident. Summary: AuroraEdge caused burst job => hit org RL => applied 3x temporary override + edge shaping => errors mitigated. Follow-ups assigned to infra and product.
Nina (Oncall): Closing handoff. I’ll add notes to the incident doc and tag postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
